review_description: I had been shopping around  for several years for an economical solar system that provided some level of off grid power.   Prior to finding Trent I had dealings with several solar installers but none seemed to think what I was looking for was possible,  As it turned out that they didn't have the required knowledge.   The solar market seems choke-full of charlatans and know nothing sales people trying to spruik you.By contrast Trent and his team took a no non-sense approach to my project.  They were very competent and totally committed to quickly completing my project.  The outcome a was professional install and exactly what I was hoping for.   Trent tested demonstrated the system operating in off-grid mode and made sure that I had the monitoring system installed and working on my phone.I highly recommend Trent Bailey and his team - you will not be disappointed.
Most of the quotes I got through your website were cheaper than the local guy, and I used them to bargain down his quote.
